questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Personal connection to the destination (heritage / friends there/ etc.)

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: a good academic course that could match with my home institution. a nice welcoming culture. a good warm climate. some nice oportunities to work with nature. rich and preserved forests.

Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: the head of studies was really available and helped me a lot. we did it together step by step.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: the professors were really available.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: most of the classes I looked upon the arrival were unavailable, so I needed to change my plan. but we found good solutions.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: don't worry if you don't have a specific plan before your arrival. everything will fit into place once you'll arrive there!

questions.answer: MA

questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: they were really interesting and some of them really useful to my study career.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: in some ways very similar, in some other very different. the teachers are friendly and keep an informal relationship with the students. the classes are more condensed in short amounts of time and often there are groupworks or papers to write.
